verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items are a fair question for an AI assistant that manages notes and documents, so the axis applies. The pack documents only adjacent features, none of which is a bulk-action capability: indexing many repositories or syncing shared folders, scheduled automations that run one query, and Python code execution as a general-purpose building block. No evidence shows Khoj selecting and acting on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
